### Borea v0.2.1

A fix release for v0.2.0. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Fixes

- Mod authors: opening the listing pull request from the App now works when your copy of content-index is older than a change to the index's own workflows. Before, it stopped with "GitHub refused access to the branch." Borea now starts the branch at a commit your copy already has, so the pull request shows only your listing file. When your listing changed in the index after you made your copy, Borea asks you to press "Sync fork" on GitHub, with a button that opens your copy. Thanks to @elevatorctln for the report.
- Saves and vehicles: Borea no longer claims that a file is open when it cannot know that. A copy, backup, restore or delete now reports the real error if one happens.

#### For mod authors

- [Make your mod work in a Borea instance](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/blob/main/docs/mod-authors.md): a mod that reads `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency` by a fixed path finds nothing in an instance. The page says what to use instead.
